judged_text: P1 (96%) packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts:8 — `await fetch(process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, {` has neither an AbortSignal nor any deadline. Every expired user credential blocks a booking/calendar request on this new remote dependency indefinitely when the configured sync endpoint accepts a connection but stalls; upstream request timeouts then turn a transient sync outage into hung/failed booking work rather than a bounded integration failure.

adjudication.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens.ts at lines 6-14 making a fetch call to process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT without any timeout, AbortSignal, or deadline mechanism. This is a real defect - if the external endpoint accepts the connection but stalls, the request will hang indefinitely. This affects critical booking/calendar operations that call this function (visible in the diff where it's integrated into GoogleCalendarService, Office365CalendarService, ZoomVideoApiAdapter, etc.). The finding correctly identifies that this missing timeout could cause hung requests during sync endpoint outages.
